                "headline": "Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 30 at 3:46PM PDT until October 1 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA",
                "description": "* WHAT...Up to 1.1 ft of inundation above ground level is\npossible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal\nwaterways.\n\n* WHERE...Bayshore locations along the San Francisco Bay, San\nPablo Bay, and Monterey Bay.\n\n* WHEN...Now through 5 PM PDT Thursday.\n\n* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only\nisolated road closures expected. High tides will result in\nflooding along coastal trails, cut off access to some low-\nlying beaches and coastal areas, and bring water and waves\nfarther up the beach than typical.\n\n* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...At the San Francisco tidal gauge, high tide\nis expected to be 1.1 ft above normal (6.92 ft MLLW) at 2:58 PM\nThursday 10/01. These predictions include up to 0.7 ft of surge\nthat will enhance the astronomical tide and flooding threat.\nHigh tide varies up to 90 minutes earlier or later along the\nPacific Coast and through the San Francisco Bay, respectively.",
                "instruction": "If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be\nclosed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of\nunknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone\nproperty.",
